statement: Preserve native DSpark context updates but compute only the KV output columns of each draft layer's quantized merged projection, eliminating discarded Q work on compatible processed MXFP8 backends.
stage: completed CPU source/layout diagnostic; implementation and service qualification deferred
mechanism: Native DSpark context preparation calls three distinct fused WQA/WKV projections on shared current target hidden states, then discards Q1280 and keeps KV512. A backend-specific output slice can omit those dead columns while preserving per-layer norm, RoPE and cache insertion.

proposed_change.initial_arm: Keep three projections and all control flow; use KV-only weight and scale views only for audited FlashInfer CuTe/CUTLASS MXFP8 layouts; full merged modules remain for actual query forward.
optional_arms: Shared input quantization only after equal actual QuantizedActivation ABI/algorithm proven.
Stack three distinct layer KV projections and batched norm/insert only after slice-only value is established; preserve layer/group-specific slots and norms.
proposed_change.fallback: Unsupported backend/packing, geometry, bias, quantization, LoRA, or lifecycle rebind failure uses unchanged full projection.
proposed_change.lifecycle: Construct/rebind views after final weight preprocessing and parameter replacement/reload; do not cache first-use pointers indefinitely.

source_grounding.claim: Context preparation computes fused Q+KV and keeps only KV.
Merged projection output splits into Q1280 plus KV512 for retained target config.

source_grounding.exact_quote: Falls back to the per-layer loop when a layer's QKV weight cannot be sliced (quantized)
source_grounding.claim: Donor explicitly excludes quantized-weight path; selective adaptation is required.
Native proposer calls context preparation; graph prefix and eager tail partition current target rows.

route: Source-profile TP1/DP4/EP4 Flash1017 native DSpark. Eager context prep handles current target rows; FULL capture handles a fixed prefix, with extra rows handled as eager tail. These partition rows; no multiplier by draft depth5 or entire historical context. Live image/backend not attested.

prior_comparison.reason: R2-03 sought to omit unused query/Markov work on unfinished-prefill iterations and had confidence-state dependencies. PJ01 keeps context preparation and removes only its discarded Q output on all applicable iterations. No query-forward, confidence scheduler, token RNG or collective omission.

counterevidence: Donor supports dense stacked weights and explicitly falls back for quantized weights; no target speed result.
Different GEMM output width may change tactic and numeric rounding. Algebraic equivalence and address checks do not prove identical context KV, proposals or confidence.
Views plausible only for exact CuTe/CUTLASS processed layouts; live selected backend unknown.
Projection may occupy too little exposed round time; normalization/insertion, query, target work or communication may dominate. Smaller GEMM may lose efficiency.
Final target output correctness cannot alone detect degraded draft KV or acceptance.
Full graph padding and profiling None slots have side effects and workspace contracts that must remain.

cpu_check.observed: 81920 exact scale-coordinate equalities; misaligned start negative yields81280 mismatches;3 extracted native control traces with shape/provenance stubs.
cpu_check.scope: No real tensor views, numeric quantized values, backend execution, loader lifecycle, model, CUDA, performance or actual KV memory writes. Independent reviewer similarly checks address equations, not additional runtime coverage.

roi.meaning: 71.43% of nominal context-projection output arithmetic only. Not latency reduction or measured HBM traffic.
roi.latency_model: If f is measured exposed round-time fraction in these context projections, r realized component duration reduction, and h normalized added overhead, total reduction=f*r-h under that decomposition. f,r,h unknown; perfect elimination cannot save more than f. Structural5/7 is not a measured r.

Compare each layer post-norm/RoPE and inserted context KV, confidence outputs, draft proposals/acceptance and graph/eager results; predeclare numerical tolerances against baseline rather than assume bitwise parity.
